about: lite-signal soak divergence registry (SPEC-B v2 section 4.4; S1cd amendments 5 and 8). Every behaviour the soak tolerates or explains has ONE entry here. divergences.mjs validates it (fail closed: classify throws while the registry is invalid) and classifies a failing world against it. Engine rungs APPEND entries at the end and flip fixedIn when their fix lands; ids are never reused. fixedIn = the rung whose fix has LANDED in the tree (null = still open); an entry with fixedIn set explains a failure only for a pre-fix control kernel (classify opts.includeFixed). fixBy = the rung planned to fix it (informative). Matching: every fail of the failing step must be explained by some entry; an entry explains a fail when the engine, lane, oracle, sig, op, step scen (all-of), world scen (all-of), prior scen (all-of, needs worldScenCounts) and at least one shape (pair, anchored detail regex, co-fail, step scen) all hold. lanes [] means no S1 matcher: such an entry names where it is observed (pending), or a conformance case, or is referenced by an allowance.

entries.decision: fix (FIX-R): a batch revert after a mid-batch read restores the computed and its effects
entries.description: set(x), read a computed, set(back) inside one batch: the computed and its effects keep the intermediate value. 1.5.2 BATCH (200/200 worlds) and ERROR batches with reads; the stale value may surface at a later step's O1c, so the step scen is not required, the world scen is.

entries.decision: fix (FIX-T): a throwing computed dependency no longer escapes the effect pre-walk
entries.description: The dependency pre-walk throws before the effect body's try/catch: the computed token escapes set()/batch() unpredicted and the effect stays queued forever (O4 in the same step). A standalone O4 or O1c computed-err-mismatch is NOT matched (4 of 4000 1.5.2 worlds; fixed by headpatched, root cause unproven, see calibration/f21-census.json).

shapes.detail: ^engine error escaped: Error: CycleError: Infinite effect loop detected\.$

entries.description: A 'flush passes exceeded' CycleError leaves stale queue entries; a later cycle-bomb effect recycles the slot and its first run throws 'Infinite effect loop detected'. Census (4000 ERROR worlds): 3 on 1.5.2/wt0/a1cand, 23 on headpatched, all on the bomb seq with an EARLIER surfaced CycleError (world count >= 2).

entries.decision: temporary (amendment 8): flips to fixedIn A2 (batch error and flush errors arrive as one AggregateError)

shapes.detail: ^predicted escape batch:\d+ x1 did not happen$

entries.description: batch(fn): fn throws, the close-flush throws too, and the flush error replaces fn's error. The batch token must be the failing op's own (batch:<step>) and the record must carry the escape. Tag F6+F22 when the replacing token is the unpredicted F6 pre-walk computed token, F22 when it is an effect-body escape.

entries.decision: model rule: a node whose last run read a since-disposed source is skipped by O1c/O1e/O2 (O4 still checks its live inputs) until its body re-runs; the skip ratio is gated per oracle (S1cd amendment 6)
